objective: 把Runtime已公开的Container context与typed transition证据投影为DriverHost不可变、真相源分类且资产缺失显式的read model

semantic_brief.summary: DesiredReality：DriverHost从Agent公开快照与既有capture catalog只读投影observed/execution/path/latest transition及refs，旧Run和缺失资产显式unavailable。ClaimUnderTest：r5快照可同时显示SettingsRoot observed与Display execution，且无第二状态owner。
core_points: ExistingEvidence：Stage A/B/C已过Leader gate，Agent.ContainerContext由belief、immutable context与trace派生
ForbiddenChange：wire、CLI/TUI、Runtime mutable state与reason parsing均由正式forbidden冻结
AcceptanceEvidence：classified fields、older-run unavailable与ref chain缺失诊断
StopCondition：需要改变Runtime authority、capture schema或新增asset owner时立即返回Leader

change_principles: AgentStateSnapshot只复制Agent.ContainerContext公开immutable projection；不得暴露live Container、ActiveContainerContext handle或mutable collection

RunSnapshot增加一个结构化Container context projection，其CurrentObservedLocation、ActiveExecutionContainer、ActiveAncestorPath为DirectPublicProjection，LatestObservedTransition与refs为DerivedReadModel；每个字段携带TruthSource
旧Run或手工快照没有structured context/transition时使用NotCurrentlyAvailable并给出明确diagnostic；不得从Reason、ContainerId或action顺序推断
CurrentObservedLocation直接来自WorldBelief projection，ActiveExecutionContainer/path直接来自Agent immutable context copy；两者允许不同且不得合并为CurrentContainer
LatestObservedTransition仅从DecisionRecord.ContainerTransition历史派生；不得新增latest cache、registry、store或mutable owner
RunSnapshotProjector可接收既有EvidenceCatalog只读参数，DriverHostObservability传入已注册catalog；无catalog时保持refs/缺失状态真实，不抛错、不发明证据
EvidenceCatalog以FreshObservationRef的结构化`observation:<positive-sequence>`关联既有observation record EvidenceRef，并通过相同FrameId关联零或多个artifact EvidenceRef；只返回logical refs与metadata，不嵌入content/body/path
transition自身已有EvidenceRef/AssetRef保持immutable历史事实；DriverHost关联结果作为read projection，不回写transition。不存在record、frame或artifact时显式MISSING_EVIDENCE或MISSING_ASSET
保持现有RunSnapshot字段、RuntimeEvent projection、GetEvidence、trace/timeline与control/wire行为兼容；不增加wire operation或transport DTO
acceptance: 真实Agent snapshot测试证明投影是copy，读者无法改变WorldBelief、execution context、path、progress、Container observation或trace
r5 read snapshot显示observed/execution分离、ordered path、latest PREMATURE transition、CompletenessRef/EvidenceRef与显式MISSING_ASSET，零reason parsing
known-empty path与unavailable path严格区分；older run没有structured event时LatestObservedTransition为NotCurrentlyAvailable而非null-direct或推断值
capture catalog测试证明FreshObservationRef关联对应PerceptionOutput EvidenceRef，并按FrameId返回logical screenshot AssetRef；locator无文件路径且不含artifact body
缺少catalog、observation record、FrameId或artifact时分别报告明确缺失诊断；不得把missing asset升级为world truth或拒绝Runtime run
DriverHostObservability注册/替换后GetRunSnapshot使用同一已注册catalog，重复读取确定性相等且不改变RegisteredRun/events/evidence
结构检查证明DriverHost没有Container字段/live handle、无新增mutable owner/cache、无CLI/TUI/wire DTO或operation变更
因本已批准change显式修改RunSnapshot read model，仅机械更新Harness frozen-source清单中RunSnapshot.cs的SHA-256，其他冻结路径/hash与guard语义保持不变
新DriverHost focused测试、既有RunSnapshot/DriverHostObservability测试、Stage A/B/C 34、冻结69、solution build、C1-C15与git diff check通过
forbidden: 禁止修改src/UniClaw.Runtime、Runtime behavior、Agent/Container authority、transition classification或accepted evidence语义
禁止新增ContainerManager、registry、NavigationGraph、route/topology、completion/recovery/action/strategy authority或持久化状态
禁止修改capture schema、artifact写入/读取权威、文件系统解析、asset body传输或checksum语义
禁止新增wire/transport/DSH/CLI/TUI/control命令；本WorkItem仅完成进程内read projection
禁止修改OpenSpec、authority docs、现有脏ObservabilityConformanceTests或scope.write之外文件
escalation: 若truth-source分类要求新增Runtime公开mutable state或live Container handle，停止并返回BLOCKED_FOR_ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW
若AssetRef关联无法由现有CaptureRecord.FrameId与CaptureArtifact.FrameId完成且需要schema/owner变化，保留MISSING_EVIDENCE并返回Leader，不扩scope
若RunSnapshot模型变化必然要求wire DTO/operation同步，停止并返回REQUIRED_HUMAN_GATE
若现有DriverHost dirty overlap或测试失败显示行为/authority delta，返回First Divergence，不修改无关文件
